[short] skip

# Set up fresh GOCACHE.
env GOCACHE=$WORK/gocache
mkdir $GOCACHE

cd $WORK
go build -o a.out

# Varying -trimpath should cause a rebuild, but not of std (go.dev/issue/57346).
go build -x -o a.out -trimpath
stderr '(compile|gccgo)( |\.exe)'
! stderr 'compile( |\.exe).* -p runtime '
stderr 'link( |\.exe)'

# Two distinct versions of the same module with identical content should
# still be cached separately.
# Verifies golang.org/issue/35412.
go get example.com/stack@v1.0.0
go run -trimpath printstack.go
stdout '^example.com/stack@v1.0.0/stack.go$'
go get example.com/stack@v1.0.1
go run -trimpath printstack.go
stdout '^example.com/stack@v1.0.1/stack.go$'

[!compiler:gc] stop

# The linker expands "$GOROOT" in std file names, or trims it with -trimpath.
go run stdstack.go
stdout '/src/runtime/extern\.go$'
! stdout '\$GOROOT'
go run -trimpath stdstack.go
stdout '^runtime/extern\.go$'

# Std should compile to the same objects with or without -trimpath.
go build -o runtime.a runtime
[cgo] go build -o cgo.a runtime/cgo
env GOCACHE=$WORK/gocache-trimpath
go build -trimpath -o runtime-trimpath.a runtime
[cgo] go build -trimpath -o cgo-trimpath.a runtime/cgo
cmp runtime.a runtime-trimpath.a
[cgo] cmp cgo.a cgo-trimpath.a

-- $WORK/hello.go --
package main
func main() { println("hello") }

-- $WORK/printstack.go --
// +build ignore

package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/stack"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(stack.TopFile())
}
-- $WORK/stdstack.go --
//go:build ignore

package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"runtime"
)

func main() {
	pc := make([]uintptr, 1)
	runtime.Callers(0, pc) // the frame for runtime.Callers itself
	frame, _ := runtime.CallersFrames(pc).Next()
	fmt.Println(frame.File)
}
-- $WORK/go.mod --
module m

go 1.14
